mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_command (id, command_id, member_id, operation, itinerary_id, expected_version, request_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{commandId}, #{memberId}, #{operation}, #{itineraryId}, #{expectedVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT command_id, member_id, operation, request_hash, result_itinerary_id, result_item_id, result_version FROM itinerary_command WHERE command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary (id, owner_member_id, title, start_date, end_date, time_zone, base_currency, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{timeZone}, #{baseCurrency}, #{status}, #{version}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO itinerary_destination (id, itinerary_id, name, country_code, time_zone, position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{timeZone}, #{position}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO itinerary_day (id, itinerary_id, day_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{date}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO itinerary_item (id, itinerary_id, itinerary_day_id, title, place_name, start_time, end_time, notes, estimated_cost, position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{dayId}, #{title}, #{placeName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{notes}, #{estimatedCost}, #{position}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_item SET itinerary_day_id = #{dayId}, title = #{title}, place_name = #{placeName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, notes = #{notes}, estimated_cost = #{estimatedCost}, position = #{position}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_item_place (item_id, itinerary_id, source, source_place_id, name, address, administrative_area_code, longitude, latitude, coordinate_system, confirmed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{itineraryId}, #{place.source}, #{place.sourcePlaceId}, #{place.name}, #{place.address}, #{place.administrativeAreaCode}, #{place.longitude}, #{place.latitude}, #{place.coordinateSystem}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE itinerary_id = VALUES(itinerary_id), source = VALUES(source), source_place_id = VALUES(source_place_id), name = VALUES(name), address = VALUES(address), administrative_area_code = VALUES(administrative_area_code), longitude = VALUES(longitude), latitude = VALUES(latitude), coordinate_system = VALUES(coordinate_system), confirmed_at = VALUES(confirmed_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM itinerary_item_place WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_member_id, title, start_date, end_date, time_zone, base_currency, status, version FROM itinerary WHERE id = #{itineraryId}
SELECT id, owner_member_id, title, start_date, end_date, time_zone, base_currency, status, version FROM itinerary WHERE id = #{itineraryId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE day_row FROM itinerary_day day_row WHERE day_row.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND (day_row.day_date < #{startDate} OR day_row.day_date > #{endDate}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM itinerary_item item WHERE item.itinerary_day_id = day_row.id )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, country_code, time_zone, position FROM itinerary_destination WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} ORDER BY position, id

SELECT day_row.id, day_row.day_date FROM itinerary_day day_row JOIN itinerary i ON i.id = day_row.itinerary_id WHERE day_row.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND day_row.day_date BETWEEN i.start_date AND i.end_date ORDER BY day_row.day_date, day_row.id

SELECT item.id, item.itinerary_day_id, item.title, item.place_name, item.start_time, item.end_time, item.notes, item.estimated_cost, item.position, item.deleted_at, place_ref.source AS place_source, place_ref.source_place_id, place_ref.name AS reference_name, place_ref.address AS reference_address, place_ref.administrative_area_code, place_ref.longitude, place_ref.latitude, place_ref.coordinate_system, place_ref.confirmed_at, place_ref.updated_at AS reference_updated_at FROM itinerary_item item LEFT JOIN itinerary_item_place place_ref ON place_ref.item_id = item.id AND place_ref.itinerary_id = item.itinerary_id WHERE item.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND item.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY item.itinerary_day_id, item.position, item.id

SELECT i.id AS itinerary_id, day_row.id AS day_id, day_row.day_date AS date FROM itinerary i JOIN itinerary_day day_row ON day_row.itinerary_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{itineraryId} AND day_row.id = #{dayId} AND day_row.day_date BETWEEN i.start_date AND i.end_date

SELECT item.id AS item_id, item.title, item.start_time, item.end_time, item.place_name, item.position, place_ref.source AS place_source, place_ref.source_place_id, place_ref.name AS reference_name, place_ref.address AS reference_address, place_ref.administrative_area_code, place_ref.longitude, place_ref.latitude, place_ref.coordinate_system, place_ref.confirmed_at, place_ref.updated_at AS reference_updated_at FROM itinerary_item item LEFT JOIN itinerary_item_place place_ref ON place_ref.item_id = item.id AND place_ref.itinerary_id = item.itinerary_id WHERE item.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND item.itinerary_day_id = #{dayId} AND item.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY item.position, item.id
